title: Improved Upper Bounds on the Size of Condorcet Domains

creators.name: Moros, Pavlos
creators.affiliation: Independent researcher, San Francisco, CA, USA

description: A manuscript and reproducibility package on upper bounds for Condorcet domains. A component reduction and deletion identity transfer an extreme-law density estimate through Moros's deletion/gap framework to the general base 32/11. The argument recovers the peak-pit base 8/3 already present in Moros's v10. Exact native certificates and a Lean formalisation with pinned dependencies are included; precise verification status is recorded in the package. This metadata is a local draft pending both authors' approval.
